text.description_html:
Laurey 37520, Hammered Merlot Matte Black Cabinet Pull

If you are looking for unique cabinet hardware, look no further. This Art Deco inspired Merlot Kitchen Cabinet Pull features a hammered design that beautifully catches the finish color to add dimension and drama to any lightweight door or drawer. The Hammered Merlot Matte Black Cabinet Pull has 3 inch mounting centers and is 4.5 inches long overall. The Hammered Matte Black Cabinet Pull comes packaged with mounting hardware.

This cabinet pull is part of the Laurey Merlot Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 37520 3 Inch Merlot Pull in Matte Black:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Matte Black
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 3"
  • Overall Length: 4-1/2"
  • Width: 5/8"
  • Projection: 1-1/4"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.
